stem.text: Part of the structure of a fungicide, strobilurin, is shown. $R$ and $R^{\prime}$ are inert groups.

stem.alt: Skeletal structure of strobilurin: a conjugated diene chain with a methyl group, a methyl ester (CO2CH3) group and a group R' on the alkene; R on the other end
stem.label: strobilurin

stem.text: In this reaction, strobilurin is warmed with aqueous sulfuric acid producing compound X. Compound X is then treated with hydrogen in the presence of a nickel catalyst producing compound Y.
What could be the structure of compound Y?

A.alt: Skeletal structure: carboxylic acid group (COOH) on a branched chain with a methyl branch, R at one end and R' at the other

B.alt: Skeletal structure: CH(OH)(OCH3) group on a branched chain with a methyl branch, R at one end and R' at the other

C.alt: Skeletal structure: CH2OH group on a branched chain with a methyl branch, R at one end and R' at the other

D.alt: Skeletal structure: three OH groups and a COOH group on a branched chain with a methyl branch, R at one end and R' at the other
